srList.sentence: Research criteria Participants were deemed eligible for the study if they: (1) practised in Germany (GER), the UK or the USA (2) were certified dermatologists or rheumatologists (3) were actively practising (ie, >=50 of time is spent caring for patients, primary practice is not researching or teaching and they are not retired) (4) had at least 3 years of clinical practice (5) had a minimum caseload (5) of female patients of reproductive age with either axSpA, PsA, PsO or RA and (6) had some experience prescribing biologics for the treatment of these conditions.

srList.sentence: Kruskal-Wallis H tests, a non-parametric test that assigns a rank based on the value of a measured score, were used to assess statistically significant differences in mean rankings of confidence scores between subgroups.44 Therefore, lower ranks indicate lower confidence in a respective subgroup.
